fields.command: git -C repo log --oneline | head && git -C repo diff HEAD~1 HEAD --stat && git -C repo diff HEAD~1 HEAD

sed -n 235,260p gars/_system/wrappers/nfcore-atacseq-wrapper/nfcore_atacseq_wrapper.py; sed -n 470,485p gars/_system/wrappers/spatial-cluster-count/spatial_cluster_count.py; grep -rln "samplesheet_samples" --include=*.py . | grep -i test; ls; ls tests 2>/dev/null | head

mkdir -p ../tmp && export TMPDIR=../tmp && python3 -c "
import sys,pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,'gars/_system'); import wrapperlib as wl
p=pathlib.Path('../tmp/s.csv'); p.write_text('sample,fastq_1,fastq_2\nA,a,b\nB,c,d\n')
print(wl.samplesheet_samples(p))" ; grep -rn "samplesheet_samples\|lines\[1:\]" tests | head; timeout 600 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | tail -15
export TMPDIR=$(realpath ../tmp) && timeout 600 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ERROR|Ran|OK|FAILED)" | head -30

export TMPDIR=$(realpath ../tmp) && rm -rf ../tmp/base && git worktree list >/dev/null; git archive HEAD~1 --prefix=base/ | tar -x -C ../tmp && cd ../tmp/base && timeout 600 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ERROR|Ran|OK|FAILED)" | head; cd ../../repo && timeout 600 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | grep -B2 -A12 "FAIL: test_08_collect_accepts" | head -40
cd <KIT> && python3 -m json.tool review.json >/dev/null && echo ok; rm -rf tmp/base
